description: This file contains C++ source code implementing classes and functions related to Android Debug Bridge (ADB) configuration and proxy setup within the Cuttlefish project. It defines helper classes for managing ADB connection modes, and command source classes for establishing ADB and socket-vsock proxy commands, integrating with the Cuttlefish configuration and kernel log system.

classes.name: AdbHelper
classes.description: Helper class providing methods to determine ADB connection modes and generate connection arguments based on the Cuttlefish configuration.

classes.name: AdbConnector
classes.description: Command source class that generates ADB connector commands based on helper's enabled modes.

classes.name: SocketVsockProxy
classes.description: Command source and kernel log pipe consumer that creates socket-vsock proxy commands for ADB, depending on configuration and connection modes.

methods.name: Commands
methods.description: Generates a list of monitor commands to establish ADB connections based on helper's configuration.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the command source, 'AdbConnector' or 'SocketVsockProxy'.

methods.name: Enabled
methods.description: Determines if the command source is enabled based on current configuration.

methods.name: ResultSetup
methods.description: Performs setup actions for the command source, such as initializing log pipes.
